name: Nilgiri (Nirigili) town
description: West-coast town of the Nilgiri Canopy-Keepers, where the coast rail meets the Meru spoke. Name still marked '?' on your chart.
notes: From the Age of Machinery chart, where it sits in 'Jambhudweep – SW'. Its position is that era's, before the Shattering; canon states no other.
